summary: The paper pretrains soccer and get-up skills, distills state-routed teachers into one 1v1 policy, trains against a historical self-play pool, and evaluates zero-shot deployment on OP3.
title: Learning Agile Soccer Skills for a Bipedal Robot with Deep Reinforcement Learning
